effect.name: GM Circle Mosaic
effect.desc: Rebuilds the layer out of discs. A square grid, a hexagonally packed grid, a jittered scatter, concentric rings inside each disc, or soap bubbles with a specular highlight. Every disc takes its colour and its radius from the layer underneath it, and the radius can be varied per disc by a hash so the mosaic does not look stamped. Per-disc shading, a soft edge, a background mix and a rotation term finish it. Built entirely in layer space, so the discs are cut from the layer's own pixels and follow it.
